occurrences.checkable_against: Diana Z. O’Brien's statement and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's biographical records
occurrences.quote_span: Diana Z. O’Brien, chair of women, gender and sexuality studies at Washington University in St. Louis, said that as a 36-year-old progressive lightning rod with political ambitions outside of the House, Ms. Ocasio-Cortez had no real choice but to make public her decision to freeze her eggs — and then, by association, her breakup.
occurrences.speaker: Diana Z. O’Brien
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.quote_span: She added: “when you get elected later in life, you’ve made all of your mistakes in private. When you get elected when you’re young, you have to do all of that in public.”
occurrences.speaker: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.quote_span: She participated in an emotional livestream after the Jan. 6 mob attack on the Capitol, describing in detail the trauma she felt from the day.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.quote_span: In her livestream on Sunday, she told her followers that the downside of being elected as a young person is “you have to then grow up in the public eye in a time that most people get to grow more privately.”
occurrences.speaker: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.checkable_against: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's online post about the Met Gala criticism
occurrences.quote_span: After she was criticized for attending the Met Gala, despite her Democratic Socialist politics, she wrote online: “I and my body have been so heavily and relentlessly policed from all corners politically since the moment I won my election.”
occurrences.speaker: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.quote_span: “I miss being able to go outside in sweats,” she told Time magazine in 2019, just after she was elected.
occurrences.speaker: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
occurrences.subject: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

occurrences.quote_span: “I can’t go anywhere in public and just be a person without a lot of people watching everything I do.”
